instruction: I need to change Chrome's DNS cache retention time to 10 minutes instead of the default. This would help me see updated DNS records faster when I'm testing website deployments.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not expose DNS cache retention time as a configurable setting. While you can clear the DNS cache manually (chrome://net-internals/#dns), the cache timeout duration is hardcoded in Chrome and cannot be modified through settings or flags.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - Chrome DNS cache timeout is hardcoded and not exposed as a configurable setting
The infeasible() evaluator function is the appropriate choice for tasks that cannot be completed
